name: Chair Thoracic Extension Mobilization
steps: Sit tall on a sturdy office chair with your back resting against the top rim of the backrest.
Interlace your fingers behind your head to support your neck.
Inhale deeply and gently arch your upper back backward over the top edge of the chair backrest.
Keep your elbows open wide and allow your chest to expand toward the ceiling.
Hold for two to three seconds at the comfortable end of extension, then exhale and return to an upright sitting posture.
coaching_cues: The chair backrest acts as a fulcrum for your middle back; do not arch from your lower back.
Keep your neck supported and avoid yanking your head backward.
Perfect for a 30-second hourly posture reset during desk work.
